summary.intent: Add a dedicated `/gsd-extract-learnings` step to the ship-phase.md workflow command.
summary.outcome: Step 11 was added to ship-phase.md, replacing a trailing mention of `/extract-learnings` with a proper dedicated step invoking `/gsd-extract-learnings $ARGUMENTS` and noting the convention that the resulting `.planning/` file commits on the phase branch/PR.

repo: The correct GSD command name is `/gsd-extract-learnings`, not `/extract-learnings`.
Learnings artifacts follow the `<phase>-LEARNINGS.md` naming convention and live in `.planning/`.
Learnings files should be committed on the same phase branch/PR, not a separate docs-only PR.

code.finding: Previously had `/extract-learnings` as an afterthought at the end of step 10; now has a dedicated step 11 with the correct command.

workflow: Workflow command files should give each distinct action its own numbered step rather than appending it as a trailing note to an unrelated step.
